_partNote: Hydrogen plant is mostly tanks and columns, so the seven tiles are pulled apart by proportion and orientation: a layered plate stack, a boxy fired furnace with a chimney, a squat wellhead valve stack, one long horizontal vessel on saddles, a sphere on legs, a very tall thin column with walkway collars, and a truck. Every subject is a single static object, and the two that could blur (the horizontal vessel and the tall column) differ in both axis and aspect ratio.

partPrompts.1: An electrolyzer cell stack standing upright on a low plain skid, seen three-quarter: a rectangular block built from several dozen identical thin square plates pressed face to face, so the block reads as a striped column of layers, capped top and bottom by a much thicker plain end plate. Slightly taller than it is wide. The layered edges are the point of the drawing. One block only, no tank, no vessel, no pipe runs.
partPrompts.2: A fired reformer furnace: a tall rectangular firebox standing on short legs, about twice as tall as it is wide, with a plain flat-paneled casing, a row of short round tube stubs projecting a little way through its flat roof, and one tall slender round flue stack rising from the top alongside them. Boxy and upright, not a cutaway, no flames, no burners drawn, no pipework running off to other equipment.
partPrompts.3: A wellhead valve assembly standing alone on a bolted base flange, seen three-quarter: a squat vertical stack of three flanged valve bodies about three times taller than the stack is wide, capped on top, with one short horizontal side outlet leaving each of the lower two bodies and ending in a plain flange, and a round handwheel on the side of the middle body. One compact valve stack, no derrick, no tower, no pipeline, no vessel.
partPrompts.4: A single horizontal cylindrical pressure vessel resting on two saddle supports, seen three-quarter: a long round tank with a hemispherical cap at each end, about four times as long as it is wide, sitting on two low curved saddles that lift it clear of the ground, with one short flanged nozzle on top near the middle. Low and horizontal; no wheels, no trailer, no legs, nothing standing upright.
partPrompts.5: A spherical storage tank: one large smooth sphere carried on a ring of six slender straight legs that meet the ground in a circle, with a small flat platform and one short vertical pipe stub at the top of the sphere. The sphere dominates the frame and the legs are thin. No cylinder anywhere, no domed-end tank, no building, no piping.
partPrompts.6: A tall slender process column standing on a low plain skirt, seen three-quarter: a smooth vertical cylinder roughly eight times taller than it is wide, ringed at three evenly spaced heights by circular walkway platforms that stand out around it like flat collars, and topped by a shallow domed head with a small stub. Very tall and thin with three collars; no legs, no motor, no sphere, nothing horizontal.
partPrompts.7: A heavy truck tractor unit seen three-quarter from the front corner: a tall flat-fronted cab with a deep windshield and two large wheels on the near side, and directly behind the cab a bank of long cylindrical tanks mounted crosswise on the frame with their round end faces clearly visible. The cab is the dominant shape. One vehicle, no trailer behind it, no station, no hoses and no dispenser.
